## findings
1. SOURCE-POLICY RED — C1-UNDECLARED (b). Symptom: two card amounts for the patient's own payment. Root cause: P5 draws credits past expiry while base "Every credit expires credit_expiry_months calendar months after its credit_date." stays in force, unnamed in P5's overwrite. Evidence: § policy_self_consistency; credits 86be36f2… (expiry 2026-10-21), d4c856a9… (expiry 2026-10-23). Consequence: 168.00 vs 82.00. Artifact: P5 overwrite/rule; tasks/1.json step 22. First revision.
2. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — FAC-P4-PERKS. Symptom: 23.00 of the 73.00 referral credit comes from loyalty/welcome/stacked tier bonuses. Root cause: referral_streak and joining_route are X1 perks; plan_family_bonus and billing_cycle_bonus re-key the tier that referral_credit_amount already prices (X3); billing_cycle_bonus's fall-through is reachable only through a pause-extended period. Evidence: P4 rule; sensitivities 70/68/68/63. Consequence: surviving factors 1 (< 4). Artifact: P4 factors. First revision.
3. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — FAC-P5-LABEL. Symptom: the same draw ladder is "method" for referral credit and "parameter" for goodwill credit. Root cause: dishonest method label; carried tiers restate the scope ("the membership is past_due"). Evidence: P5 factors. Consequence: P5 has 0 honest method factors (< 1). Artifact: P5 factors. First revision.
4. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — FAC-P3-CLIN. Symptom: +3.00 because the cancelling clinician is the primary clinician (+1.00 had it been another). Root cause: a goodwill differential no practice publishes (X5). Evidence: P3 rule; sensitivity 55.00. Consequence: 3.00 of the 58.00 credit rests on an invented treatment. Artifact: P3 factor cancelling_clinician. First revision.
5. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — FAC-P6-FILL. Symptom: member pharmacy pricing recaptured at 6.00 on a fill whose member pricing saved 3.00 (cash 15.00, member 12.00). Root cause: flat recapture not keyed on the benefit (X5). Evidence: rx_charges 68848e7f…, rx catalogue Core 30-day 15.00 / Plus 20 %; sensitivity 711.00. Consequence: the scored upgrade charge carries a recapture larger than the benefit. Artifact: P6 param upgrade_rx_recapture / factor fills_used. First revision.
6. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — A3-P6 and R6-COND6 (charter-global, cited from `_difficulty.md` § findings 10 and § r6_grading); on this world every scored value rests partly on [schedule] factors (goodwill +33.00, referral +33.00, carried draws 86.00, recaptures 117.00).
7. Charter-global findings bearing no demonstrated consequence on this world (cited): `_difficulty.md` § findings 2–9 (D1-DEADLOCK: this world's waits are satisfiable).
